summary: Master infrastructure finance and project appraisal with practical modeling, risk analysis, and bankability tools. Enroll to build approval-ready funding cases.
lede: Project and infrastructure finance training covers funding structures, cash-flow appraisal and the evidence used to assess project bankability. It is for professionals evaluating infrastructure funding, preparing appraisal papers or supporting project finance decisions. Learners build cash-flow models and test viability using NPV, IRR, debt-service measures and scenarios; they also design capital stacks, map risks, conduct due diligence and prepare recommendations for lenders and sponsors.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who evaluate infrastructure funding, prepare appraisal papers, or support project finance decisions across public and private settings. Project finance analysts who build funding cases and cash-flow models. Infrastructure investment managers who assess transaction viability and bankability. PPP coordinators who structure risk allocation and approval materials. Financial analysts who test debt capacity and scenario assumptions. Project officers who prepare appraisal notes and investment briefs. Corporate finance managers handling infrastructure capital allocation. Development finance specialists evaluating blended finance and concessional structures. Commercial managers negotiating lender terms and financing conditions. Treasury professionals supporting debt sizing and funding strategy. Public-sector infrastructure planners reviewing affordability and value for money.
modules: Financial Appraisal and Cash Flow Analysis
PPP Structuring and Value for Money
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software installed, since the course uses financial modelling and sensitivity analysis exercises. You should also be prepared to work from sample project assumptions, cash-flow schedules, and appraisal templates provided during the training.
